summary: Iteration 59: Trainer Vibe & Music Search API Testing Complete. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Verified music search proxy (iTunes API), vibe CRUD endpoints (PUT/DELETE), auth requirements (401/403), and profile vibe fields. Expo web build compiled successfully (82 routes). Static code analysis confirms all new components exist with expected features.

frontend_issues.note: Frontend is React Native/Expo - cannot be tested via browser. Static code analysis performed instead.

GET /api/music/search?q=eminem&limit=5.description: Returns results with trackId, trackName, artistName, artworkUrl, previewUrl, trackViewUrl

PUT /api/trainer-profiles/{userId}/vibe.description: Saves vibeTrackTitle, vibeArtistName, vibeArtworkUrl, vibePreviewUrl, vibeAppleMusicUrl, vibeTrackId

GET /api/trainer-profiles/{userId}.description: Includes all vibe fields in response
